feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 7 August 2026 10:40pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 07 August 2026 at 10:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over the English Channel will drift eastwards, allowing a weak weather front to affect the Irish Sea on Sunday.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 overnight, then increasing 4 or 5 again tomorrow morning. Locally Variable 2 or 3 at times in Liverpool and Morecambe Bays.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in central and western waters.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, soon decreasing 3 or 4, veering West or Southwest on Sunday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain and drizzle developing.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in precipitation, perhaps poor in a few places at times.
